transcript: I was gonna watch one more episode of adults before I go to bed but then I watched three episodes and now it's 2:00am and who was gonna tell me who was gonna tell me I heard these notes and knew immediately I was not prepared I was not prepared yeah honestly though she's good you could have given me 1,000 guesses I never never never never would have guessed Les Miz and it brings me so much joy and I don't know if this was a reference I'd love to know but it's giving Dawson's Creek season 1 where Joey sang on my own at the beauty pageant adults is just a show for theatre kids I don't know if they know it but they are they really are I mean the cameos I just never know where the show's gonna go and I love it anyway if you’re looking for a really great show adults now I'm gonna be up to finish the whole season
